title: Onboarding HUD: low-vision & dark-theme contrast pass, scalable icons, and motion-reduction assets
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Perform a focused accessibility and dark-theme pass on onboarding/quickstart HUDs and screenshots. Deliver new art assets (SVGs/PNG variants), updated product screenshots in light and dark modes, and microcopy adjustments for focus states and low-vision contrast. Coordinate with frontend engineers for implementation and QA. Target WCAG AA for all new visuals and AAA for text where feasible.
deliverables: Updated onboarding HUD mockups in Figma (light/dark)
Set of production-ready screenshots for docs and quickstart templates (PNG 2x/3x, dark/light)
Motion-reduction variants for animated onboarding (Lottie + static PNG fallbacks)
Accessibility annotation layer in Figma with contrast numbers and focus order
acceptance_criteria: All onboarding text meets WCAG AA contrast (4.5:1) in both light and dark themes
Primary HUD icons have consistent stroke widths and pass visibility checks at 16px
Motion-reduced onboarding flows available as static assets and documented
Screenshots approved by PM and Design, uploaded to docs asset bucket
Implementation review sign-off from ENG and Accessibility specialist
accessibility_targets: WCAG AA for normal text (4.5:1) across all screenshots
Aim for AAA (7:1) on key CTA labels in onboarding where contrast permits
Color ramp documented with hex values and contrast metrics
Iconography to support 2x-3x pixel density with clear shapes and 1px+/consistent strokes
qa_steps: Export screenshots from Figma at 2x and 3x and upload to /docs/assets/onboarding/2026-03
Run contrast checks using axe-core and Chromatic visual diffs for both themes
Manual low-vision verification (zoom 200%, high contrast system mode) on macOS and Windows
Verify motion-reduced flow shows static image when prefers-reduced-motion is set
Confirm icons render crisply at 16/24/32 px across supported browsers

2026-03-13 - Liam C: Added motion-reduction static fallbacks and uploaded 2x/3x PNG exports. Ready for visual QA.
2026-03-14 - Aisha K: Requesting final review from Jamal (Accessibility) and PM Elena before PR to docs. Targeting completion 2026-03-28.
